function.name: caldav_list_calendars
function.description: List all calendars configured in Kairos-MCP. Returns calendar IDs, names, and whether each is writable. Call this first to discover valid calendar_id values for other tools.

function.name: caldav_list_events
function.description: List events from a calendar in a date range. Returns event list with UIDs, titles, times, and attendees. UIDs are needed for caldav_update_event and caldav_delete_event.

date_min.description: Start of date range, ISO 8601 with timezone offset (e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to today if omitted.

date_max.description: End of date range, ISO 8601 with timezone offset. Defaults to 30 days from date_min if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

function.name: caldav_daily_brief
function.description: Get today's calendar brief: all events for the day, free-slot analysis (gaps over 15 minutes where new meetings could be scheduled), total calendar time, and a ranked list of today's attendees. Use for morning briefings, scheduling help, or questions about what's happening today.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Defaults to UTC.

function.name: caldav_create_event
function.description: Create a new calendar event. Returns the created event's UID — save it if you need to update or delete it later. Events starting within 15 minutes cannot be modified after creation.

start_time.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with timezone offset (e.g. '2026-08-20T09:00:00-04:00'). Must include a timezone offset.

end_time.description: End time, ISO 8601 with timezone offset. Must be after start_time.

all_day.description: Set to true for all-day events (times are ignored). Defaults to false.

recurrence_rule.description: Optional RFC 5545 RRULE value for recurring events, e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR'. Omit for a one-off event.

function.name: caldav_update_event
function.description: Update an existing calendar event using PATCH semantics — only fields you provide are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. Events starting within 15 minutes are locked. The recurrence_rule of a recurring event is immutable — delete and recreate if you need to change the recurrence pattern.

uid.description: The event UID from caldav_list_events or caldav_create_event.

title.description: New title (max 200 characters). Omit to leave unchanged.

description.description: New description. Omit to leave unchanged.

location.description: New location. Omit to leave unchanged.

start_time.description: New start time, ISO 8601 with offset. Cannot be changed on a recurring event. Omit to leave unchanged.

end_time.description: New end time, ISO 8601 with offset. Cannot be changed on a recurring event. Omit to leave unchanged.

attendees.description: New full attendee list (replaces the existing list entirely). Omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: New status. Omit to leave unchanged.

function.name: caldav_delete_event
function.description: Permanently delete a calendar event. Events starting within 15 minutes are locked. Always confirm with the user before deleting — this cannot be undone.

uid.description: The event UID from caldav_list_events or caldav_create_event.

function.name: caldav_gateway_health
function.description: Check Kairos-MCP health: shows each configured calendar source's connection state and circuit-breaker status. Use to diagnose connection problems before other tools fail.
